products.name: LiqMint Individual
products.portfolio_role: Commercial wedge; share infrastructure with institutional edition
products.target_user: Self-directed stablecoin users with a recurring need to inspect wallet activity; exclude people seeking guaranteed yields.
products.economic_buyer: Individual subscriber; finance operator only where permitted by the product entitlement.
products.long_term_value: A persistent history of decisions, understandable controls and repeatable review workflows. Sell reduced preparation effort and traceability, never investment performance.
products.pricing_strategy: Keep the configured $19.99/month retail anchor during validation; free education and bounded exploration. Add $49 advanced usage only after entitlement, support and margin evidence. Annual commitments follow demonstrated retention.
products.partner_strategy: Wallet educators and qualified software integrators gain useful educational workflows. Propose at most 15% of collected net software subscription fees for 12 months, subject to margin floor and legal review; no payment tied to trades, AUM or yield.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: Useful stablecoin explainers → interactive learning → verified signup → first reviewed workflow → requested referral. Track repeat review, not wallet funding.
products.physical_sales_trigger: No field sales for retail. Founder handles early interviews; add remote customer support only after recurring workload justifies it.
products.us_review: Assess FinCEN/state money transmission if funds are accepted/transmitted; SEC/state adviser/broker scope if advice or securities transactions are involved. Noncustodial branding alone does not decide applicability.
products.value_proof: First useful review within one session; repeat reviews at 30/90 days; support minutes and retained paid cohorts.
options: Reprice usage-heavy plans after measured support/inference costs.
Redesign supported chains and workflow quotas with clear disclosures.
Limit referral fees to software subscriptions.
Withdraw an unsupported regulated activity before withdrawing educational software.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.

products.name: LiqMint Institutional
products.portfolio_role: Commercial B2B engine; controlled treasury workflow
products.target_user: Small treasury and finance operations teams at fintechs or digital-asset businesses; begin with one workflow and a named risk owner.
products.economic_buyer: Treasurer/CFO owns budget; operations champion uses it; risk, legal and security can veto.
products.long_term_value: Institutional memory, consistent approvals, audit preparation and fewer manual handoffs. Expand after measured workflow adoption, not promises of risk elimination.
products.pricing_strategy: Propose a fixed-scope $2,500–$5,000 paid pilot, then $1,500–$5,000/organization/month plus defined usage and implementation. These are price tests, not current contracted prices. No unlimited bespoke work.
products.partner_strategy: Accounting firms, treasury consultants and integrators receive implementation/service revenue. Propose 10% of collected net first-year software fees for qualified referrals; certified resellers negotiate a wholesale discount within a contribution floor. No transaction/AUM fee by default.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: Public controlled demo → treasury checklist → founder discovery → paid shadow pilot → approved reference → integrator introductions.
products.physical_sales_trigger: Founder-led remote sales first. Consider an enterprise seller after 5 repeatable paid pilots, 3 references and sufficient contracted contribution to cover the role. Travel only for security/procurement workshops with documented deal value.
products.us_review: Activity-based FinCEN/state/SEC review, customer data controls, contractual responsibility and sanctions obligations. Treasury software is not automatically a licensed intermediary.
products.value_proof: Agreed pilot success criteria; measured approval turnaround and audit-preparation time; renewal and multi-workflow adoption.
options: Reprice per organization/workflow rather than assets handled.
Reduce integrations or service coverage to a supported package.
Separate partner implementation fees from subscription referrals.
Decline or exit costly bespoke commitments with contractual transition duties.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.

products.name: OraToPlus
products.target_user: Job seekers and working professionals with an upcoming interview or presentation; coaches and employers managing repeated practice.
products.economic_buyer: Individual for self-serve; coach, L&D lead or career-services director for groups.
products.long_term_value: A repeated practice-and-feedback habit with personal progress history. Prove improvement on the same task over time; do not claim guaranteed hiring or fluency outcomes.
products.pricing_strategy: Observed catalog: Free, Growth $49, Enterprise $299. Keep those anchors initially; test a bounded $19 entry tier only if cost/retention evidence supports it. Price group plans by active learner and practice minutes, with explicit AI limits.
products.partner_strategy: Coaches retain their own coaching fee and use the tool between sessions. Propose 20% of collected net first-year subscriptions or a volume reseller discount, never both on the same sale; margin cap applies.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: One useful free practice scenario → feedback viewed → repeat attempt → coach-led cohort → consented learner recommendation. Publish only measured, permissioned outcomes.
products.physical_sales_trigger: No physical sales for individuals. Remote partnerships first; institutional visits only after repeatable cohort results and a qualified employer/university procurement opportunity.
products.us_review: Clear subscription/cancellation terms; recording and consent practices; employment-related scoring must not be marketed as a validated hiring decision system without appropriate assessment.
products.value_proof: First feedback viewed, second attempt completed, four-week practice retention, measured learner outcomes and support/audio cost per minute.
options: Reprice by practice minutes for expensive use.
Offer shorter sessions or narrower feedback coverage.
Pay coach commissions after collection/refund window.
Withdraw unprofitable language/scenario promises before the core practice offer.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.

products.name: WeddingOS / WeddingPro
products.portfolio_role: Commercial B2C acquisition and B2B recurring engine
products.target_user: Engaged couples beginning planning; independent planners and small venues managing multiple weddings.
products.economic_buyer: Couple for a single event; planning-business owner or venue operator for recurring workflows.
products.long_term_value: Couples need confidence through their event, not an indefinite subscription. Professionals need reusable templates, reliable handoffs and repeat-client operations. Build lifetime value through successful events, referrals and professional adoption.
products.pricing_strategy: Keep three public tools and up to 20 registered saved results free. Test a $49 one-time enhanced couple plan only after paid features exist. Test professional software at $49/month, team/venue at $99–$199/month; do not change live pricing until billing and entitlements are verified.
products.partner_strategy: Planners and venues reduce coordination work and keep their own service fees. Propose 20% of collected net software revenue for 12 months, capped by contribution; separately disclosed, contracted vendor commissions only where appropriate. Never monetize organic ranking secretly.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: Free calculator/checklist → verified account → first saved result → shared planning experience → planner/venue introduction. Useful planning guides and partner embeds; no bought lists or unpaid-review manipulation.
products.physical_sales_trigger: No physical sales for couples. Founder demos for planners; venue-chain account sales only after 10 retained professional accounts and 3 references. Visit only when a multi-site deal warrants it.
products.us_review: Marketplace principal/agent accounting, clear fees and affiliate disclosure, subscription consent, privacy and vendor responsibility. Insurance, travel or financial services require activity/state-specific review before compensation.
products.value_proof: First saved result, completed planning milestone, professional monthly repeat use, event-level contribution and referral quality; separate couples from professionals.
options: Reprice advanced professional workflows, not currently free public tools.
Redesign event/storage/support coverage explicitly.
Pay from collected net software fees, not all vendor booking value.
Withdraw a loss-making marketplace service while preserving customer data/export obligations.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.

products.name: Memoir
products.target_user: Families making wedding, travel, baby and tribute photo books; photographers serving recurring client occasions.
products.long_term_value: Finish and preserve meaningful books with repeat occasions and a photographer channel. Design continuity, reliable fulfillment and reorders create value; an annual consumer subscription may be a poor fit.
products.pricing_strategy: Free preview; test $29 digital project/export and clearly quoted print orders. Print price must cover actual supplier, shipping, reprint/refund, payment and partner costs. Studio software can be tested separately after repeat demand.
products.partner_strategy: Photographers keep their photography revenue and can sell a disclosed book-design service. Printers receive predictable, quality-approved orders; revenue share comes only from the attributable book contribution, not a partner’s entire profit.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: Permissioned sample book → free preview → completed paid project → occasion/reorder reminder with consent → studio referrals.
products.physical_sales_trigger: Remote studio onboarding first. Physical channel sales only after 5 repeat studios, verified fulfillment margins and a defined regional cluster.
products.us_review: Photo rights, privacy, fulfillment/refund promises and principal/agent classification. Do not count printer or shipping pass-through amounts as platform margin without an accounting assessment.
products.value_proof: Preview-to-completion, on-time delivery, reprint/refund rate, contribution per book and repeat occasions.
options: Reprice by pages, format and fulfillment route.
Limit free renders/storage and supported print formats.
Share contribution after returns and supplier costs.
Stop a loss-making print route while maintaining digital export.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.

products.name: Jodibana
products.target_user: Trusted community and matchmaking operators who can recruit both sides of a viable local/community network.
products.economic_buyer: Community owner or matchmaking business; members are a distinct user group.
products.long_term_value: Sustained network quality, moderation and member trust, not a promised match. Help operators run a safer, responsive service and retain their own legitimate membership/service revenue.
products.pricing_strategy: Observed catalog: Free, $49 Growth, $99 Pro, $199 Enterprise monthly. Start with operator SaaS; avoid charging members before local network liquidity and safety practices are demonstrated. Active subscription rows do not establish paid revenue.
products.partner_strategy: Operators retain disclosed membership/service earnings and pay a software fee. Prefer fixed SaaS or a clearly scoped share of collected platform fees; never imply a claim on all matchmaking profits.
products.zero_ad_spend_path: One trusted community pilot → verified onboarding → useful member interactions → operator case study with consent → adjacent community introductions.
products.physical_sales_trigger: Founder-led community partnerships first. Local relationship visits only when a repeatable, safe operator model and positive retained contribution are established.
products.us_review: Sensitive data, community safety, identity/consent, age controls and honest relationship claims. Assess any regulated ancillary offer separately.
products.value_proof: Balanced active network, response rate, moderation resolution, operator renewal; do not use registrations alone as evidence of liquidity.
options: Reprice operator usage above bounded allowances.
Narrow geography/community coverage to improve quality.
Separate software, membership and service fee responsibilities.
Withdraw an unsafe or persistently inactive community with member notice and data handling.
products.strategy_status: Founder-review hypothesis; not a published offer
products.scenario_assumptions: Illustrative monthly cohort, not a forecast or live paid-user baseline. Costs and demand response require measurement.
